items.summary: Approve containment-only execution for this cycle. Continue existing measurement, failure repair, attribution reconciliation, legal evidence, security evidence, and finance reconciliation work. Do not create or requeue implementation work, experiments, telemetry, deployments, spending, credentials, dependencies, domains, or monetization changes. Preserve SEO, UX, content, affiliate, CRO, and site-factory opportunities as deferred backlog until ownership, isolated validation, rollback, release, security, attribution, and measurement gates clear. Existing evidence does not support revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal-lift claims.

Continue the existing delivery containment and failure-repair review. Before any dispatch or requeue, record dated ownership, root cause, smallest isolated repair, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, release, security, attribution, and measurement evidence. Use existing recorded telemetry only; do not invent or request duplicate telemetry.

Retain the existing fleet security evidence matrix and private launch gates. Use authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing launch-readiness evidence work and keep the gated product private. Keep permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Do not change launch state, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, or deployment.

Continue the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate provider earnings as unattributed. Reconcile matching periods and recorded cost categories without inferring site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, or causal lift.
